system.notes: In ages past, the Legionnaires were a military force to be reckoned with. In those days this Dynamistic effect was used to rally forces from around an entire battlefield to a central location. By focusing their will, the Legionnaire can create the image of a huge battle standard in the sky, 60 meters above their location. The standard, usually a glowing golden Monad, is as large as personal starship. In addition, the Legionnaire’s voice is amplified to be as loud as thunder, so that they might issue orders to everyone in the area.
